name: Water Release: Heavenly Mirror of Hope

system.description:
You manifest a ring of water that creates a reflective film similar to that of a mirror. When you are targeted with a jutsu, you quickly raise this mirror showing your targets reflection. You manifest an exact duplicate of the triggering creature as this duplicate casts the same jutsu, forcing a Clash.

This jutsu’s cost becomes equal to twice the triggering creatures jutsu cost.

On a successful Clash, you functionally cast the triggering jutsu, using your current position as part of the jutsu’s calculations. If the jutsu would be a melee attack, the triggering creature is the only possible target. If the jutsu is a cone or a line, you must angle it so that the triggering creature is in the affected area.

You use your jutsu’s save DC’s to calculate the Save DC of the reflected jutsu.

On a failure, your mirror shatters, you suffer the effects of a Clash, and you are Stunned from the backlash until the end of your next turn.

trigger.text: 1 Reaction, which you take when you take damage from an attack or as a result of a jutsu whose range is either a Line or Cone.
